name: io.github.x402-video/mcp
description: Pay-per-call AI video generation over x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys.

environmentVariables.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Spending wallet private key (USDC on Base). Only required for the paid generate_video tool; quotes and polling work without it.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Hard spend guard in USD — generate_video refuses quotes above this (default 5).
